name: Avax S.A.
summary: Avax S.A. operates as a construction company in Greece and internationally. It operates through Construction, Concessions, Real Estate, Energy, and Other Activities segments. The company engages in design and construction of new power plants, LNG terminals, and storage facilities, as well as natural gas pipelines. It is also involved in real estate development and investments. The company was formerly known as J&P-AVAX S.A. and changed its name to Avax S.A. in May 2019. Avax S.A. was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Marousi, Greece.
